$comment: Docker Engine test matrix (#29). Single source for internal/testharness (LoadMatrix) and the extended workflow's engine-matrix job. Images are the official docker:<version>-dind images pinned by multi-arch index digest; update version, image and apiVersion together. The 'minimum' entry is DockYard's minimum supported Engine (#21, #25 Q2) and must match engine.MinSupportedAPIVersion; 24.0.9 was dropped after failing a v1 operation (docs/support-matrix.md).

engines.note: Lowest Engine passing every planned v1 operation (#21). API 1.44 is also the lowest API version Docker Engine 29 still accepts from clients.
